minutes_text:
Inglewood, California
  August 3, 2021

The Parking Authority of the City of Inglewood, California held a regular meeting on
Tuesday, August 3, 2021, in the Council Chambers in City Hall of said City.

Following the Pledge of Allegiance to the flag of our Country, Mayor Butts called the
City Council into joint session with the Successor Agency, Housing Authority, Parking
Authority, and Joint Powers Authority at the hour of 2:01 p.m.
The City Clerk/Successor Agency Secretary/Housing Authority Secretary/ Parking
Authority Secretary/Joint Powers Authority Secretary announced the presence of a
quorum as follows:

  Present:  Mayor/Successor Agency Chairman/Housing Authority
  Chairman/ Parking Authority Chairman/ Joint Powers
  Authority Chairman Butts, Council Members/Successor
  Agency Members/Housing Authority Members/ Parking
  Authority Members/ Joint Powers Authority Members
  Dotson, Padilla, Morales, and Faulk; and
  Absent:  None.
City/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/ Parking Authority/ Joint Powers Authority
officials and personnel present were as follows:
  Aisha L. Thompson  City Clerk/Secretary*
  Artie Fields  City Manager/Executive Director*
  Ken Campos  City Attorney/General Counsel*
  David Esparza  Assistant City Manager
  Angela Allen  Deputy City Clerk

* Serves as indicated for the Successor Agency, Housing Authority, Parking Authority,
and Joint Powers Authority.

PUBLIC COMMENTS – AGENDA ITEMS.  Mayor/Successor Agency
Chairman/Housing Authority Chairman/ Parking Authority Chairman/ Joint Powers
Authority Chairman Butts inquired if there were any persons present who wished to
address the City Council/Successor Agency/Housing Authority/ Parking Authority/ Joint
Powers Authority on any item on the Agendas other than the public hearings.
Ray Lawson, Southwest Regional Counselor of Carpenters Business Representative,
spoke regarding an apprenticeship program to keep Inglewood residents working on
projects such as SoFi Stadium, Metro Rail, and the Clippers Arena. He stated he wanted
to keep workers working when these projects end and wanted information on evolving
the project labor agreement. He also mentioned that one of their goals was to keep
Inglewood residents employed to afford to live in the city.

Parking Authority Member Morales left the dais at 2:04 p.m.

Parking Authority Member Morales returned to the dais at 2:06 p.m.

PARKING AUTHORITY MINUTES. It was moved by Parking Authority Member
Morales, and seconded by Parking Authority Member Faulk that the Minutes for the
Parking Authority Meeting held on March 23, 2021, be approved. The motion was
carried by the following roll call vote:
Ayes: Parking Authority Members Dotson, Padilla, Morales, Faulk, and Parking
  Authority Chairman Butts; and
Noes: None.

There being no further business to be presented, Chairman Butts adjourned the meeting in
memory of Theola Gardner, neighbor of Council Member Dotson, Gloria Gibson-
Morrison, Century Heights Member, and Malcolm Bennett, Apartment Owners
Association President at the hour of 2:56 p.m.
 August 3, 2021

  Approved this 12th day of October, 2021.

  ________________________
  Aisha L. Thompson, Secretary

  ________________________
